name: – David McAllister – § 28 – Am 154
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – 2024 annual report
part_text: 28. Affirms the right of Israel to defend itself as enshrined in and constrained by international law; recalls that Israel has the obligation to address the risk of mass starvation and the outbreak of disease epidemics in Gaza; recalls that Israel also has the obligation to protect the civilian population and that military operations must be proportionate and in line with international humanitarian law; notes the military action by the Israeli Defence Forces in the Gaza Strip and in the West Bank and in Lebanon to ensure that an attack like the one on 7 October 2023 can never happen again; calls for an immediate and permanent ceasefire including the unconditional release of all hostages;
